profile_text.body:
Pegasystems Inc. is a public company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, trading under the ticker PEGA. Its site describes it as an AI-powered platform for enterprise transformation, and says the world's largest organizations have trusted it since 1983 to automate workflows, personalize customer experiences, and modernize legacy systems.

The company's own material centers on AI for enterprise operations. It describes its AI agents as operating with context, compliance, and human oversight, and says Pega Platform unifies AI for mission-critical work. It names Infinity 26 as its latest platform release, intended to help enterprises build, orchestrate, and scale AI, and Pega Blueprint as an AI-powered workspace that brings business and IT together with governance and best practices.

Beyond the site, the company is recorded as a for-profit public company with CIK 0001013857. Its law exposure is recorded in Massachusetts, with a count of 143. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for it.
